snippet.title: Shoot The Zombirds Teaser by iDreams - a game for iOS & Android
snippet.description:
Check out the official teaser trailer for the forthcoming release of Shoot the Zombirds! The game already hits beta status and soon will be released on the Google Play and the Apple App Store. Please remember to thumbs up if you like this video
More info at: www.idreams.pl
